title: Create CharacterCreator and RelationshipSettings React components
description:
Create two React components for the companion identity configuration UI.

Component 1 — react_ui/src/components/CharacterCreator.tsx:
- A form panel for creating or editing the companion's CharacterProfile
- Fields: name (text input), backstory (textarea, 3-5 lines), personality sliders (range inputs for each personality dimension: openness, conscientiousness, extraversion, agreeableness, neuroticism, curiosity, creativity — each 0.0–1.0 with step 0.05), humor_style (select dropdown), communication_style (select dropdown), favorite_topics (tag-list input: text field + add button, rendered as removable chips)
- Accepts a sessionId prop
- On mount, fetches current CharacterProfile via getCharacterProfile(sessionId) and populates the form
- On submit, calls updateCharacterProfile(sessionId, formData)
- Shows loading state during fetch, error state on API failure
- Uses Tailwind CSS for styling (dark theme compatible: bg-gray-800, text-gray-100, etc.)
- Follows existing React component patterns: functional component, interface for props, named export

Component 2 — react_ui/src/components/RelationshipSettings.tsx:
- A settings panel for configuring the relationship
- Fields: type (select: friend/mentor/peer/partner/custom), tone (select: warm/neutral/formal/playful/sarcastic), directness (range slider 0.0–1.0), warmth (range slider 0.0–1.0), initiative_level (range slider 0.0–1.0), content_level (select: light/moderate/deep/intellectual)
- Accepts a sessionId prop
- On mount, fetches current RelationshipConfig via getRelationshipConfig(sessionId)
- On submit, calls updateRelationshipConfig(sessionId, formData)
- Shows loading/error states matching CharacterCreator pattern
- Uses Tailwind CSS for styling (consistent dark theme)

Both components import API methods from react_ui/src/api/client.ts. Do not duplicate the API logic.

Expected files: react_ui/src/components/CharacterCreator.tsx (created), react_ui/src/components/RelationshipSettings.tsx (created)

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- react_ui/src/api/client.ts (import available API methods and types)
- react_ui/src/types.ts (existing type patterns)
- react_ui/src/components/ (existing component patterns, styling conventions, Tailwind usage)
- react_ui/src/App.tsx (how components are composed)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed paths. Do NOT wire these components into App.tsx or any parent view — that is an integration step for a separate task. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed files modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.
